verdicts.reason: A: the headline and CTA are legible and read left to right, but the CTA button is oversized and outweighs the headline. The body copy is squeezed into a 7-line sliver against the right edge, too small to read, and the can and SOLSTICE logo are gone. B: it keeps the can and has a sensible badge–product–headline–CTA flow, but every piece of text is tiny. The headline is no bigger than the 3-line subcopy, so the hierarchy fails, and the CTA label is unreadable at this size.
